# AI Architecture Vault

The whiteboard, script and code behind every [@ai.transition](https://instagram.com/ai.transition) reel. Each part is one reel: something that breaks when you build with LLMs, the mechanism behind it, and the rules that fix it.

**Came from a reel?** Find it below by the title on its cover. Each part's folder opens with the whiteboard, the rules and any code.

**New here?** Start with [Part 16](parts/16-paid-twice/) for an agent that takes real actions, [Part 12](parts/12-half-the-tokens-3x-the-bill/) for what an LLM bill is made of, or [Part 11](parts/11-prompt-injection/) for prompt injection.

## Tracks

**Engineering** changes code inside a system you've already decided to build. **AI Product** changes what gets built, or whether. Every product part names the engineering part it stands on.

## How a part folder is laid out

`README.md` (start here) · `canvas.jpg` (the whiteboard) · the code or template, if the part has one · `script.md` (full breakdown) · `_production/` (cue cards, captions, metadata, master cut). Details in [CONTRIBUTING.md](CONTRIBUTING.md).
